hook.text: On this album he plays the cavaquinho for the first time, an instrument he had dropped for the guitar.

sentences.text: Some of the samba musician's songs were recorded on this LP, among them 'Juízo Final', 'Folhas Secas', 'A Flor e o Espinho', 'Rugas' and 'Quando Eu Me Chamar Saudade'.

listen_for.text: Guilherme de Brito is a special guest on this track.
